criteria_location: Section I (page 1-2): A non-wound indications, B wound therapy (initial and adjunctive), C topical. Section IV description includes technical chamber requirements (>= 2.0 ATA, ASME PVHO-1).

logic.top_level: pathways (non-wound list; wound initial list; wound adjunctive with sub-criteria)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Topical HBOT experimental; HBOT 'should not be a replacement for other standard successful therapeutic measures'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: B.1 'Initial therapy' vs B.2 'Adjunctive therapy' (not repeat; they are indication groups with different prerequisites).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Preparation and preservation of compromised skin grafts (not for primary management of wounds) i. Acute traumatic peripheral ischemia ii. Crush injuries ... iii. Gas gangrene iv. Progressive necrotizing infections
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Sub-items i-iv are indented under item a (skin grafts) in text, although they are separate indications; a parser would nest them wrongly

and_or_ambiguity.quote: only medically necessary after there are no measurable signs of healing for at least 30-days ... iii. Patient has failed an adequate course of standard wound therapy
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 30-day rule stated in the lead-in, 'failed' in the leaf; do they overlap?
